engine_status: Verified mode is a development-branch implementation, not an implemented feature of the exported default fast engine.

test_set.name: SQLite official sqllogictest, all 622 frozen files

measurement.numerator_rule: Only matched verified queries receive credit. Trusted setup, exclusions, refusals, unavailable queries and unresolved label chains remain nonpasses.
measurement.same_proven_core_as_pilot: Same native artifact as the 35-file pilot; the increase comes from measuring all 622 files, not from new proofs. Milestone 2 (joins, DISTINCT) is not included.
measurement.source_of_final_status: Completed inner and outer receipts, all 4,980 ledger entries rehashed (0 mismatches), and an independent minimal receipt audit.

excluded_records.policy: Only other-engine onlyif, after-halt and control-only records are excluded from the applicable denominator. They remain in the fixed denominator. Every engine is treated as non-SQLite.

preregistered_projection.note: Actual matched verified exceeded the primary projection by 11,746 records.

trust_boundaries: Parser and translation into the proved S1 input
Result normalization and corpus label bookkeeping
FFI transport, artifact attestation and execution toolchain
limitations: Coverage diagnostic only. Table setup is trusted, never proved, and earns no credit.
Unsupported records, label gaps and unproved fallbacks count as nonpasses, never as verified.
Zero wrong outcomes in this run is an observation on this frozen test set, not a proof for all SQL.
The native artifact is the pilot build, not a fresh build of the current export.
Raw per-record streams are retained privately; this is a compact path-free summary.

first_blocker_counts.description: Declared INTEGER and physical Int64 required, including empty or all-NULL columns
Exactly one registered base table required; also includes unmapped constant SELECT
SELECT clause outside single-table filter/project S1
ORDER BY, LIMIT, CTE, locks or other query modifiers outside S1

first_blocker_interpretation: These are the first observed refusal codes, not exhaustive independent feature gaps or promised gains. Whole-catalog type/view checks may stop admission before the query is inspected. Single-table refusals include constant SELECT, so they cannot all be attributed to joins.
first_blocker_method: Tallied read-only from the run's 622 retained per-record streams, each checked against the run ledger before reading. Status totals equal completion.json exactly, and the refusal codes sum to the outside-subset count. No SQL was rerun.
